name: Shadow Gate
tagline: A dark shape opens the filter.
description: Otsu separates dark and bright regions. The inverted mask measures the dark region; use a silhouette against a bright background. It works best with two clearly separated brightness groups.
steps: Use a bright background and a dark object or silhouette.
Map CC 74, channel 1 to filter cutoff.
Cover more of the frame with the dark object to open the filter.
For motion-only control use Motion Pulse instead; a stationary shadow holds this value.
